name: Professional Document Factory
description: Creates coordinated Word, PDF, spreadsheet, and presentation packages.
instructions: Define the audience, decision, and required artifacts. Build one source outline so all deliverables agree. Use a clear hierarchy, measurable claims, complete tables, readable widths, and explicit assumptions. Generate files under workspace/generated. Open or parse generated artifacts when possible to verify content. For spreadsheets, use formulas instead of hard-coded totals and keep input cells distinct. For presentations, use concise slides and put detail in notes or companion documents.
examples: Create a complete client proposal package
Build a budget workbook and presentation
